name: Prochorus
title: One of the seven deacons
summary: Prochorus was one of the seven men chosen by the early church in Jerusalem to serve at tables and ensure the fair distribution of food to widows. He was selected because of his good reputation, wisdom, and being filled with the Holy Spirit.

keyEvents.title: The selection of the seven deacons
keyEvents.description: Prochorus was chosen along with six other men to serve the church in Jerusalem when discontent arose among Greek-speaking Jews regarding the distribution of food to widows.

keyEvents.title: Laying on of hands by the apostles
keyEvents.description: After the church chose the seven men, they were presented to the apostles, who prayed for them and laid hands on them, thus ordaining them for service.

keyEvents.title: The Result of Deacon Service
keyEvents.description: After the seven were appointed to their service, the word of God continued to spread, and the number of disciples in Jerusalem grew greatly.
